Stage 9, predicted by hand from the printed instructions before recording: As no_child.4000 but born on January 1, 1961: 65 or older for the standard deduction (sa.age65 yes), yet born after December 31, 1960, so Step 4, question 2 is Yes and the credit is the same $308 (p. 41; BUG-0034).
Stage 9, predicted by hand from the printed instructions before recording: As no_child.4000 but born on or after January 2, 2001: Step 4, question 2 is No.

Stage 9, predicted by hand from the printed instructions before recording: As no_child.4000 but the filer could be a qualifying child of another person: Step 4, question 5 is Yes, STOP (p. 42).

Stage 9, predicted by hand from the printed instructions before recording: Head of household, one child, wages $25,000 and interest $5,000 (AGI $30,000, investment income $5,000). Line 2: printed row $25,000-$25,050, one child, $4,060 (p. 52); line 4 No; line 3 is not less than $23,350, so line 5 is the row $30,000-$30,050, one child, $3,261 (p. 53); line 6 is the smaller, $3,261.

Stage 9, predicted by hand from the printed instructions before recording: Head of household, two children, wages $15,000 (building up; the plateau begins at $17,880). Printed row $15,000-$15,050, two children: $6,010 (p. 51).

Stage 9, predicted by hand from the printed instructions before recording: Single, no qualifying child, no wages, interest $1,000: earned income is $0, below the table's first row, so line 2 is zero and the credit stops (ambiguity register amb.2025.eic_below_table).

Stage 9, predicted by hand from the printed instructions before recording: Single, no qualifying child, wages $19,104: Step 1, question 1 is No (the amount must be less than $19,104).

Stage 9, predicted by hand from the printed instructions before recording: Single, no qualifying child, wages $1: the first table row, $1-$50, no children, is $2 (p. 49).

f1040.line27a.remedy: A filer excluding foreign earned income can't take the EIC; Form 2555 and excluded income are outside this tool.
